text: I will rejoice and exult in you; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
The enemy has been cut off and has vanished in everlasting ruins, You have uprooted their cities; The very memory of them has perished.
And those who know Your name [who have experienced Your precious mercy] will put their confident trust in You, For You, O LORD, have not abandoned those who seek You.
The LORD has made Himself known; He executes judgment; The wicked are trapped by the work of their own hands. Higgaion (meditation) Selah.
Put them in [reverent] fear of You, O LORD, So that the nations may know they are but [frail and mortal] men. Selah.
